correctness.rationale: The definition is the INTERSECTION-NUMBER semigroup C_n Z^n∩Z_nonnegative^n over C, not the original dimension-two Du Val singularity. The A_n Cartan determinant N=n+1 and weighted congruence phi(a)=sum i*a_i (mod N) have equal index and C_n columns in kernel, hence lattice equals kernel and X_n=A^n/mu_N weights 1..N-1. Stabilizer of order d fixes indices divisible by d, codimension N−N/d>=2; no pseudoreflections, so Chevalley–Shephard–Todd reduces singular support to prime-order fixed-image Z_p, irreducible incomparable components of dimension N/p−1. Generic stabilizer mu_p yields transverse weights j repeated N/p for j=1..p−1. Toric character-lattice class group Z/N and canonical character weight nN/2 give index 1 for even n, 2 for odd. For group element of order d the exact fractional age is (N−N/d)/2; all >=1, >1 iff n>=4. For center EXACTLY at origin, interior cocharacter lift adds N/d−1 zero residues and reaches (N+N/d)/2−1, minimized at d=N -> n/2; identity class contributes n. Independent exact calculations confirmed age/interior/terminal statements for 3<=N<=54. Distinction between closed-cone age and strict interior mld is essential.
